data.title: Consolidate spreadsheets with a reconciliation receipt
data.summary: Join recurring exports into one workbook while checking keys, duplicates and totals.

facts.text: ChatGPT can create and revise spreadsheets from supplied sources; review methods differ by surface. Generated files still need content and calculation checks.

prerequisites: Access to ChatGPT Work with file creation; check account, client and workspace availability.
Authorized CSV/XLSX copies with source dates and an agreed row grain.
steps: Inventory input files, row counts, columns and expected totals before joining.
Agree a composite key and duplicate policy; retain the original rows and provenance.
Map column types, currency and dates. Distinguish blank values from zeros.
Join into a review copy; create an exceptions sheet for unmatched or conflicting records.
Recalculate the workbook and compare input/output counts and totals. Inspect the actual saved file.
data.output: a consolidated workbook, exceptions sheet and reconciliation receipt
validation: List conflicting rows and apply only the agreed policy.
Keep the record visible in exceptions; do not silently drop it.
limitations: Sintra-authored procedure based on provider documentation or demonstrations; no execution in the named app was performed.
Availability and results depend on your inputs, enabled tools and permissions; a suggested practice result is not a measured outcome.
data.prompt: Consolidate [authorized exports] into a review copy of [existing workbook]. First inventory rows and columns, propose the join key, and ask about ambiguous duplicate rules. Keep source rows and provenance. Preserve zero versus missing values, units and currencies. Return a formula-based workbook, exceptions sheet, input/output row counts and reconciled totals. Open/recalculate the saved workbook where supported; report exactly what was checked and what remains untested.
tips: Ask for input/output row counts alongside totals.
Use formulas for derived metrics and open the result in a compatible viewer.
